name: Communicating With The Dead
overview: Scripture clearly forbids any attempt to communicate with the dead or engage with familiar spirits, warning that such practices defile the believer and provoke God's judgment. The Law commands the outright rejection of wizards, necromancers, and those who consult spirits, with severe consequences including being cut off or even death. These prohibitions underscore the finality of death, as the psalmist declares that when a person dies, their thoughts perish, affirming that seeking knowledge or guidance from the dead is both futile and sinful.
